title: Call logs on caller profiles
summary: Staff, volunteers and students can now log phone calls on a caller's page once the caller is verified. Callers never see these logs.
changes: Add a Call log to the Callers page with the date, direction, a summary and who took the call.
Calls can only be logged after the caller passes the PIN check.
Call logs are visible only to staff roles and administrators, never to the caller.
Each new call log is recorded in the audit log.
version_rationale: Patch: adds a call log table and panel to the Callers page; no existing data changes.
validation: New feature test for logging after verification, invalid input, display and keeping logs from the caller.
Caller verification, translation and authorisation tests.
Full PHPUnit suite and the MySQL contract job in CI.
known_limitations: Call logs cannot be edited or deleted yet. Automatic removal of old logs follows in the next release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. The new table can stay; earlier releases ignore it.
provenance: Milestone v0.49.3 Beta, issue #479 under epic #475, pull request #605.
